guide.summary: Early launch, few customers, no partner status (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none); Public multi-customer app, certified partner (partner acceptance).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Early launch, few customers, no partner status (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none). Hardest: Public multi-customer app, certified partner (partner acceptance).

composio.note: No Composio managed app for Xero. Create a custom auth config with your own client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed Xero app, so you must register your own Xero app and give Composio its client ID and secret.
reasons: No managed Xero OAuth app exists in Composio
Consent screen shows your brand instead of Composio's
Managed apps share quota across all Composio users

scenarios.label: Early launch, few customers, no partner status
scenarios.when_this_applies: You connect a small number of customer Xero organisations before joining the App Partner Program.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; c25, c26

waiting.basis: No review is documented for creating the app; the cap is only from a developer report (c20)

scenarios.approval: Path unconfirmed: Xero docs found do not say whether outside customers can connect an unreviewed app. A developer reports a cap of 25 connected clients until app partner approval.

scenarios.label: Public multi-customer app, certified partner
scenarios.when_this_applies: Many customers outside your company connect, and you want to lift the cap and list in the Xero App Store.

hands_on.basis: estimate from steps; beta customers needed (c19), assessment takes about 5 working days (c15)

waiting.basis: No verified source backs this timeline (the agent's estimate was "5-10 working days for security review; partner acceptance time unknown").

scenarios.approval: Apply to the Xero App Partner Program, pass a security assessment reviewed by Xero's security team, and complete certification and listing review.
extras: Reported caps: 25 unapproved, 100 after first approval

modifiers.note: Reported caps: 25 unapproved, 100 after first approval

prerequisites.title: Xero developer account
prerequisites.detail: Register your app to get a client ID and client secret. Develop against the demo company at no cost.

prerequisites.title: Beta customers lined up
prerequisites.detail: New apps must onboard 10 beta customers (non-demo tenants with API calls in the last 30 days) before the certification form unlocks.

prerequisites.title: Security standard readiness
prerequisites.detail: The assessment covers authentication, encryption, personnel security, audit logging and more. Two-step authentication is the minimum, and Sign in with Xero already provides it.

prerequisites.title: Stripe and regions for paid listings
prerequisites.detail: If you sell through Xero App Store Subscriptions, set up Stripe and target regions first. It is available only in Australia, New Zealand and the UK.

steps.title: Register the Xero app
steps.detail: Log in to the Xero developer portal, create the app and note the client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Check redirect URI against Xero rules
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard. Verify it is absolute and has no wildcards; up to 50 are allowed.
steps.done_when: Redirect URI is saved in the Xero app.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config for the xero toolkit via Composio's API with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: A test user can connect the demo company.

steps.title: Onboard 10 beta customers
steps.detail: Get 10 real organisations connected and making API calls within 30 days.

steps.title: Draft listing and assessment answers
steps.detail: Prepare listing copy and draft security self-assessment answers against Xero's standard.
steps.done_when: Drafts are ready for your review.

steps.title: Apply and implement Sign Up with Xero
steps.detail: Apply to the App Partner Program, implement Sign Up with Xero, then submit the listing and assessment.
steps.done_when: Submission is accepted in the Developer Centre.

steps.title: Wait for Xero review
steps.detail: Xero assesses answers in about 5-10 working days and emails the result; follow-up questions are possible.

traps.title: Connection cap before approval
traps.detail: A developer reports unapproved apps are capped at 25 connected clients, rising to 100 after approval. Plan launch volume around this.

traps.title: Beta-customer requirement stalls launch
traps.detail: A developer's launch stalled on the earlier beta-customer rule, now 10 customers. Start onboarding early.

traps.title: Refresh tokens expire after 60 days unused
traps.detail: Users must reauthorise the app after that, so schedule keep-alive calls for idle connections.

traps.title: Single page apps not supported
traps.detail: Use a server-side or native flow. Composio on your servers is fine.

traps.title: Stricter review at scale
traps.detail: At 1,000+ connections an advanced security assessment is required. The assessment must also be repeated every year.

blockers.what_it_means: Xero sends a remediation report and the app is not certified or listed.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit a remediation plan within 30 days and implement changes within 60 days, then wait for re-review.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan and track the deadlines.
